avis.texte: In the past while using pads like these, I noticed I wouldn't see too much of a benefit. It wasn't until my cousin who knows all things about kbeauty advised me that you can get a lot more of the ingredients into your skin if you kinda piece them together on your face to form a sheet mask of sorts. Ever since I started doing that, I noticed a lot more benefits for my skin. I've also become familiar with the fact that the ingredient lists are not always fully listed, and that seems to be pretty common with kbeauty and jbeauty products. I do wish the description had more of the intended purpose and at least the main ingredients, as not everyone will have prior knowledge of the specific brand or product. I always look up my products prior so that I can be aware of the full ingredient list because I do have some ingredient sensitivites. You get a good amount of pads for the price point, though if you're using it as a mask, it's obviously not going to last you as long. I have combo skin, where my cheeks are really dehydrated and my tone is oily. These really helped my cheeks look much more bouncy and hydrated after wearing the pads as a mask. Everything absorbed well, and my husband noticed my cheeks looked much more plump and hydrated than usual.

I bought these pads for the back of my hands because I have very dry skin in this part and I have tried everything, they were incredible I put them at night then I apply the centella tonic also from mixsoon and my moisturizer and my skin has seen an incredible change.

I really like MIXSOON brand of skin care. This is a clean brand which uses as few ingredients as it can.. I really like the way this toner makes my skin feel. I would definitely recommend looking at this brand, it has quality ingredients and very reasonably priced better than some high-end skin care.

avis.titre: Lo mejor para tu rutina de cuidados
avis.texte: "Estas almohadillas son muy prácticas y deian una sensación refrescante. Ayudan a preparar a piel para los siguientes pasos de la rutina y aportan hidratación. En mi caso, la piel quedó más suave y con mejor aspecto después de usarlas de forma constante. Son ideales para quienes buscan una rutina rápida y cómoda."
Lo mejor! Me ha funcionando para reducción de mis poros. No me irrito y mi piel está brillante ✨
Soy mquillista y me encantan para preparar las pieles de mis clientas
Fabulous- helps my skin feel hydrated and smooth- for me also has a calming affect when used after medicube Age R derma boost pro

I am a big fan of Mixsoon, but this one disappointed me big time due to the smell. Not really sure it went bad while being delivered or just the nature of the product..... Really want to find out since I love the ingredients.

avis.titre: Super thin toner pads; tons of toner
avis.texte: These toner pads are made of an eco‑friendly cellulose fabric, and they’re so thin they practically disappear into the skin (see my photo). Because of that, they stick incredibly well and mold to the face beautifully when they’re fully saturated, which makes them perfect for quick DIY masking. I love placing a few on my cheeks and forehead for a cooling refresh or to calm any irritation. One downside is that you can’t leave them on for too long since the edges lift once they start to dry. Also, because the pads are so thin, sometimes I accidentally grab more than one at a time. And they’re not great for wiping across the skin since they fold over or collapse into themselves easily. I found that folding a pad into quarters helps make it more substantial so I can swipe without it crumbling. There's tons of toner in the tub so the pads are extremely juicy. The top pads are fine but the ones in the middle and bottom of the tub get a bit messier to handle because of all the excess toner. But the upside is that even though the pads are thin, one has more than enough toner to cover my face, neck, and even my décolletage. The toner pads aren’t abrasive at all, and the toner itself gives my skin a nice mix of moisturization, soothing, and an instantly cooling feel. Once everything absorbs, it leaves behind a soft, cushiony tackiness that's not sticky or uncomfortable. The formula is also very gentle. When my skin barrier is compromised, overly dry, or I’ve been using actives, my skin

avis.titre: Thick for toner but this is the first time I've used collagen toner
avis.texte: I'm a fan of Mixsoon brand. The jar is first just beautiful! The amount of toner pads is very generous. There is a lot of serum in the jar so the pads are very saturated. The thing I didn't like is that the pads are all over the place and that makes it a little harder to grab just 1. I thought I had grabbed one with the included tweezers but it was 2. The serum is thick like collagen and felt more like collagen serum than toner. Toners are usually more watery and dissipates quickly. This serum was thick and slick, it was on my skin for a good 5 minutes before it absorbed into the skin. The pads are smooth and it was a little difficult using it due to the slickness of the serum and the flat pads. But after all that, once my skin was prepped, it felt very soft and clean and ready for next steps.

avis.titre: Great Toning Pads, Hydrating, Half A Pad Is Enough For My Whole Face
avis.texte: I am reviewing this "mixsoon Hyaluronic Acid Toner Pad 6 Fl. Oz. / 180ml Soothing, Hydrating Toner Pads For Sensitive." I was looking for another toner since I recently ran out of what I was previously using. I love trying Korean skincare products. Pros: -Comes in a nice little 6.08 fl oz plastic jar with flip top lid -Came with proper safety seal intact -Has cute little plastic tongs for picking up pads attached to inside of lid -Includes 80 circular toning pads -Honestly they are large enough to where I will probably be cutting them in half every time to extend my use of this product. I used a full one the first time and it stayed moist for so long. I cut one in half and that was sufficient for my whole face -Pads are super saturated with the toning serum -Extremely gentle on my sensitive skin and have not caused any irritation -Can be used as a toner or left in place as a hydrating mask -Dual-Textured: one side is super soft, slick, smooth and the other side is more textured/ slightly rough. The soft side is clearly the side that should be used to initially apply the toner as it glides so easily across the skin; you could flip to the other side after, though it is a little hard to use this side without the pad bunching up -These are super hydrating and my skin feels soft and healthy after using -Works well in my skincare/ makeup routine -Has a nice barely there scent without added fragrance in the ingredient list Cons: -It does mention this on the package, but even with th

The posted description is far too minimal, I think. The box itself is also quite terse as well, although it does have the complete ingredients listed which I'm attaching to this review. (Perhaps the target audience for this product already knows full well what this is, how to use it, and what to expect?) Anyway, from what I see, there are multiple hydrators, including hyaluronic acid. There is niacinamide sitting near the top in prominence, known for brightening. The collagen helps with skin sensation and moisture retention. The adenosine and sodium DNA would be intended to fight against wrinkles and to provide some soothing benefits. My understanding is that sodium DNA is basically a version of the trendy PDRN ingredient, just not as purified or potent as the injectable/medical product. The preservatives seem modern and likely to be non-irritating for most people. In my usage so far, this toner feels great. I've been using the pad to simply wipe across the skin. It glides nicely and seems to absorb well. The directions also suggest for a more intensive experience to leave the pad in place for 10 minutes. I didn't try that yet, though. I haven't notice any residue, and so far I've not experienced any negative reactions. There are 110 toner pads in the container, according to the product shot in the listing, which matches the front of the container I received. For the asking price, I think this becomes a great bargain for a really solid product.

As someone who has super dry and sensitive skin, I am happy to report that ever since incorporating these toner pads into my skin care regimen, I noticed a significant improvement in my skin's hydration levels. As someone who never believed in toners, these toner pads have changed my mind! These toner pads are extremely hydrating, more hydrating than any other toner pad that I have tried before. Each pad comes thoroughly soaked with toner, making it super easy to use. When my skin is feeling extra parched, I like to let these toner pads sit on my skin for an extra 5-10 minutes to let the product absorb better into my skin, and it feels like a quick hydrating mask. A tip is to keep these toner pads in the fridge during the summer to make your skincare session extra refreshing! I was a little bummed that the toner pads arrived all tossed up inside the tub, but the good news is that each toner pad is still thoroughly and equally saturated.

avis.titre: Nice dual-textured skincare pads from a Korean skincare brand
avis.texte: I am enjoying using these hyaluronic acid pads when I want to lightly clean and refresh my face without any drying or stinging. One side has a a micro-bump texture, and the other side is smooth.See pic 2. I should note that I do have sensitive skin and mild, well-controlled rosacea (can be flared by the wrong products though), and some products do cause stinging or irritation., This one does not irritate my skin at all, rather it leaves my skin feeling hydrated, calm, and refreshed. After I have used the bumpy side a wake up and gently cleanse my skin, I like to use the smooth side on my forehead as a mini-mask. I love that the formula ibis paraben-free and does not contain other ingredients I like to avoid. There are numerous ingredients I know are great for my skin and healthy skin barrier, including glycerin and hyuralonic acid (moisturizi8ng), panthenol (mositurizing and soothing), and sunflower seed oil (helps repair skin barrier). You can see list of ingredients in pic 3. .I like how they include tweezers built into the lid to remove the pads with to help avoid contamination (see pic 1). Product is made in Korea (see 4th pic). Very happy with this product.

This is just a really good, hydrating toner pad. It doesn’t set out to do too much more than that, but sometimes, a boost of hydration is all I want. It’s got a lot of different kinds of hydrators including glycerin, panthenol, and different forms of hyaluronic acid. There’s also vitamin E and sunflower seed oil, though they are the last ingredients in the toner pads. There IS Methyl Diisopropyl Propionamide which can give you a nice cooling sensation, which I really enjoy, but if your skin is sensitive, please be aware and maybe consider patch testing. This also does give the toner pads a really really light scent. This comes in a pretty container and is quite full of essence. It also comes with mini tweezers to minimize your contact with all the other pads, which I always appreciate. These toner pads lend themselves well to DIY masking. I put two on each side of my face, and split another in half for the top and bottom half of my face. It helps to boost hydration and just make my skin feel really nice, especially when I feel I need a little more self-care or want to take a minute for myself.

These Hyaluronic Acid Toner pads are my new favorite additions to my skincare routine! I've been using these in the morning after washing my face and they make my skin look and feel great! They give my face a nice suble glow, which I usually avoid with my oily skin! It also makes my skin nice and soft, and although I love my serums I don't think it's really necessary when using these, I just use some moisturizer with UV protection after they absorb. They don't have any scent to them, and the textured pads are so big you can probably cut them in half. I like that it also comes with a tiny little spatula just in case you need it. Overall they're really nice and I recommend them!

These toner pads are extremely thin, so while you could just wipe your face with them, I found that the best use for them is toner masks. As such, they cling to my face exceptionally well and looks almost transparent, largely disappearing into my skin – until I’m ready to take them off 10 minutes later. At which point, I do wipe the remaining essence into my skin. Using them as masks also helps reap more benefits from the great ingredients, which are rich in hydrators and soothers such as Hydroxyethyl Urea, Propanediol, Adenosine, 3 forms of Hyaluronic Acid, collagen and PDRN. (Full ingredient list in my photo.) Lastly, I will note that the masks are not neatly stacked inside the jar but all mixed together, but luckily handy plastic tongs are included for retrieving them. Hope my review was helpful to you.

These toner pads are thin and adhere well to my face, making them perfect for a quick toner mask. They did arrive mixed up in the jar, not stacked, but the little tweezer in the lid makes it pretty easy to grab one at a time without touching the rest with your fingers. They have pretty standard ingredients for toner pads, with the addition of sodium DNA (a form of PDRN), so they stand out from others based on that. Also, they are fragrance-free, which I appreciate especially when using as a toner mask.

The mixsoon Hyaluronic Acid Toner Pad 6 Fl. Oz. comes with 80 pads in a container. I prefer these toner pads that are already soaked in a cotton round to save me some time, plus it's easier for traveling. Each pad has the perfect amount of toner to apply on my whole face. After cleansing, I applied this toner and it left my face feeling cool and moisturized. I did not have any reaction with my sensitive skin. I have used many products from this brand and never had any issues with the quality. Made in Korea.

avis.titre: Super convenient, very saturated toner pads
avis.texte: I was very impressed with these mixsoon hyularonic acid toner pads! They are much more saturated than I expected them to be, and one was enough for my face and neck. It was very gentle and not noticeable astringent or drying. I feel like my skin looked quite calm immediately after applying this toner. I really like it and I think I'm going to use it as my primary toner in my routine going forward.
